experiment: AC Rescue Lab — isolated second-stage candidate-generation lane for unresolved Amazon AC products

isolation.evidence: scripts/experiments/ac-rescue-lab/*.ts issue SELECT-only queries against production (asserted via a hard project-id check on the DB URL before any query runs); 02/03/04 read only local JSON files written by prior steps and touch the database not at all (04 makes read-only SELECTs against tps_listing_price_facts and price_history, both derived/append-only tables, never an identity table); no file outside scripts/experiments/ac-rescue-lab/ imports anything from it; no scheduled job, API route, or UI references it.

literature_check.framework: Fellegi-Sunter (1969) record linkage: comparison vector -> match/non-match/possible-match-for-review, with blocking as a standard pre-filter for candidate generation.
literature_check.verdict: The founder's proposed architecture (attribute-fingerprint blocking + hard-conflict gate + abstention) is a legitimate, well-established entity-resolution pattern, not a novel or risky invention. Abstention ('no candidate' / 'ambiguous') maps directly to Tawveeri's own 'unknown beats incorrect' principle.

run_B_minimal_fingerprint.note: used only to characterize blocking-key looseness; not carried into ranking/classification — the founder full fingerprint is the trustworthy tier.

exactly_one_candidate_hypothesis.verdict: FALSE as a general property of raw blocking — most eligible products land on 0 or 2+ raw candidates, not exactly 1. However, a RANKING step (score = matching_attributes - missing_attributes) recovers a de-facto unique best candidate in several multi-candidate cases when one candidate has a clear, unambiguous lead — see ranking_results.

hard_conflict_gate.purpose: reject any raw candidate with a PROVEN disagreement (both sides stated, values differ) on cooling_mode, technology, series_or_platform, or model_number — regardless of how many other attributes agree.

ranking_and_classification.method: within a surviving candidate set, rank by (matching_attributes.length - missing_attributes.length); classify by whether the top candidate is unique, has full agreement (0 missing), and holds a clear score lead over the runner-up.

price_experiment.hypothesis_tested: does price add real discriminating signal beyond attribute matching?
price_experiment.starting_assumption: price must NEVER be a primary identity key — this experiment can only confirm 'weak corroborator at best' or 'drop entirely', never promote price to a primary key.

true_match_pairs.excluded: 1 pair (LG FreshDV) had amazon_price=0, a scraper stock/price-capture artifact, not a real price — excluded rather than treated as a mismatch.
true_match_pairs.finding: all 3 usable true-match pairs show EXACT price equality (ratio = 1.000).

weak_or_ambiguous_pairs.finding: 2 of 17 weak/ambiguous (unconfirmed, NOT proven-same) pairs ALSO show exact ratio=1.000, and several more cluster tightly around 1.0 (0.955, 0.988, 0.992, 1.008) — indistinguishable from the true-match cluster by price alone.

price_experiment.verdict: PRICE_USEFUL = NO as a standalone or primary discriminator. Exact price equality is consistent with a true match (all 3 usable true pairs hit it) but is NOT SUFFICIENT on its own — a meaningful fraction of unconfirmed/ambiguous candidates hit the identical exact-equality signal by coincidence (same brand+capacity tier retail prices cluster together in this market). Price was correctly excluded from the confidence-classification logic in this experiment (Step 3) and should stay excluded from any production-facing scoring; it may be retained only as a non-decisive footnote a human reviewer can see, never as an input to an automated decision.
price_experiment.sample_size_caveat: n=3/17 is small; this is a directional finding, not a statistically powered one. It corroborates rather than overturns the mission's own starting assumption.

voltage/phase variants (110V vs 220V, single vs three-phase) — not extracted

red_team.disclosure: These modes were NOT exercised against the real candidate set this session — time/scope did not permit constructing or locating real examples of each. This is an honest gap in the red-team coverage, not a claim that the system was tested against them and passed.

ai_llm_role_assessment.method: analytical, not a live pipeline — no LLM or vision model was actually invoked against candidate pairs this session.
ai_llm_role_assessment.reasoning: the deterministic blocking + hard-conflict-gate baseline already achieves what the mission asks an AI layer to justify: zero known false positives in the RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE tier (n=4, all now exact-price-corroborated), full explainability per candidate (matching/missing attribute list), and a real abstention behavior (AMBIGUOUS/NO_CANDIDATE/HARD_CONFLICT) that costs nothing in false-merge risk. An LLM asked to adjudicate the same 26 candidates would be reasoning over the same title text the deterministic parser already reads — it could not see anything the parser missed (extraction coverage is the real bottleneck, evidenced by the 1.1% series_or_platform coverage), and unlike the deterministic gate, an LLM's mistakes are neither reproducible nor free (latency, cost, and a non-zero false-merge rate on ambiguous cases where 'sounds plausible' is not the same as 'proven'). A multimodal (image) pass could plausibly help on genuinely visual attributes (unit form factor, indoor/outdoor split) that text never states — but none of the AMBIGUOUS or REVIEW cases in this run were blocked by a visual-only gap; they were blocked by attributes (technology, series) that are textual and simply absent from the trusted-side source data, which an image would not supply either.
ai_llm_role_assessment.verdict: AI/LLM_ROLE = NOT WARRANTED for this narrow rescue lane as currently scoped. Deterministic extraction-coverage improvement (more of the founder fingerprint stated per product) is the higher-value lever than adding a probabilistic adjudication layer on top of an already-small candidate set.

metrics.candidate_recall_note: cannot be computed without a true, independently-sampled gold set of ALL true matches in the population (unknown ground truth) — only candidate PRECISION-adjacent signals are computable from this lab's organic gold set.
metrics.rescue_high_confidence_precision_on_gold: 4/4 (100%) of the RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE class's gold-set members are corroborated by full attribute agreement and, where price was usable, exact price match — but n=4 is too small to generalize a false-merge rate.
metrics.hard_negative_catch_rate_on_gold_set: 3/3 (100%) of known real hard-negative cases in this run were correctly rejected by the hard-conflict gate.

coverage_gain_over_270_product_populatio.verdict: this is a narrow, precision-safe rescue path, NOT a volume solution — the mission's own instruction not to judge by 'links more products' is honored: the yield is small and is reported as small.

metrics.false_merge_cost_vs_abstention_cost: the hard-conflict gate and the 3-way (PROVEN/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS) split are explicitly designed so abstention (NO_CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS/HARD_CONFLICT — 18/26 = 69% of the eligible population) is the default outcome, and only 4/26 (15%) reach a tier that would even be eligible for any downstream trust — consistent with false-merge cost >> abstention cost.

verdict.reasoning: The core mechanism (attribute-fingerprint blocking + hard-conflict gate + ranked classification + mandatory abstention) is architecturally sound (matches established record-linkage literature), demonstrably safe on real data (hard-conflict gate correctly caught 3/3 real near-misses, zero known false positives in the top tier), and solves a real, previously-documented problem (it independently and correctly re-resolves the ADR-077 LG ArtCool/FreshDV confusion twice). It is NOT strong enough for unattended production adoption because: (1) the founder full-fingerprint coverage that makes RESCUE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE trustworthy is only 9.6% of the Amazon AC catalog, so the reachable population is inherently small (yield 1.5-3.0%); (2) the gold validation set is small and organically-surfaced, not independently sampled, so the measured 100% precision figures are directional, not statistically powered; (3) several real failure modes (Wi-Fi variants, T1/T3 rating, voltage, indoor/outdoor-only listings) were identified but not empirically red-teamed against real cases this session. It is NOT weak/unsafe — every gate that exists worked correctly every time it was tested against real data. It IS needed as a concept (it rescues real, otherwise-unresolvable cases) but not yet ready to ship.

productionization_proposal_status: NOT PREPARED — results are PROMISING, not 'exceptionally strong' by the mission's own bar for triggering a productionization proposal (small reachable population, small unpowered gold set, incomplete red-team). If the founder wants to pursue this further, the recommended next step is enlarging fingerprint coverage (series_or_platform extraction is the single biggest lever, currently 1.1%) BEFORE proposing any production wiring, since coverage — not matching logic — is the binding constraint on this lane's reachable population.
limitations_disclosed: MODEL_NUMBER_COVERAGE and MPN_COVERAGE both show 0.0% in this lab due to an imprecise raw_observations join (exact raw_name = products.name_en string match, which silently fails on any scrape-session title drift) — ADR-318 already established the true, more carefully-verified figure is 2/270 (0.7%), which does not change any conclusion here given how small it is either way. Disclosed rather than silently left inconsistent with ADR-318.

the gold validation set (11 cases total) is organically surfaced, not independently/blindly sampled — a genuine limitation the mission asked to avoid; time/scope this session did not permit building a larger blind-sampled set.

systematic red-teaming against the mission's named failure modes (Wi-Fi, T1/T3, voltage, indoor/outdoor-only, renewed condition, stale specs) was not performed — only the organically-found Haier hot/cold case constitutes real red-team evidence.
AI/LLM and multimodal value was assessed analytically from the deterministic baseline's own measured behavior, not via an actually-invoked LLM/vision pipeline this session.
